summary.text: Brian Strickland is the Republican nominee for Attorney General of Georgia. A trial attorney from Henry County, he serves in the Georgia State Senate and chairs its Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Valdosta State University (B.B.A. in economics, 2006) and the Florida Coastal School of Law (J.D., 2009).
Member of the Georgia State Senate (District 42); chaired the Senate Judiciary Committee in the 2021-22, 2023-24 and 2025-26 sessions.
